description.value: Kynoch Adventures is Bella Coola Valley's longest-running ecological interpretive tour company, founded in 2002 and now in its second generation of operation. The company specializes in guided grizzly bear viewing by raft on the Atnarko River in Tweedsmuir Park, wilderness eco-rafting on the Bella Coola River, and guided alpine and forest hikes in the Great Bear Rain Forest. For cyclists touring the Chilcotin Highway (Hwy 20), this is the primary outfitter for wildlife and wilderness experiences in one of BC's most remote and spectacular valleys.
